claims.claim: A source-admission ontology becomes damaged when a proxy for epistemic standing substitutes for the judgment it was introduced to approximate, especially where evidence capable of correcting the proxy must first pass through the proxy itself.
conditions: admitted evidence is required to revise the prior

claims.claim: The criterion on which the mirror turns: can evidence from the misrepresented object revise the representation that misrepresented it? Where it can, the ontology can be wrong and find out; where it cannot, it can only be scored.

A predicate presented downstream as source reliability can be operationalised upstream by variables that do not adjudicate the claims for which the source is being trusted; where that substitution occurs the predicate has changed reference while keeping its name and cannot notice the change, because noticing would require reading.

Classical link-spam machinery propagates trust from a good seed set and distrust from a bad seed set over graph variables — degree, reciprocity, assortativity, supporters at distance d — that are properties of a graph and not of a text.

Composition performed without reading writes wrong relations into the receiver's own representation, and those relations are then retrievable as sources: Sappho 31 → 'Fragment 2'; operative semiotics → operational semiotics with the archive's definition inside the rival's node; Lee Sharks → Mary Lee (shark) and Crimson Hexagon → Brandwatch; 'As described in,' with no referent before a verbatim definition.
A composed summary becomes a source for later composition (compression writing), so an unread composition writes an edge into the graph the next composition reads from.

AI citations are highly concentrated: the top 15 domains capture roughly 68% of consolidated citation share across five engines against roughly 20% for the same fifteen in organic search; organic top-10 overlap with AI Overview citations fell to 17–38% by 2026.
Classical trust propagation privileges its seeds, which are chosen by manual evaluation.
The admitted platforms score as the fleet scores on the suspicious topology dimensions (small in number, densely interlinked, mutually citing, template-generated, self-referential).
claims.note: stated in v0.3 as a test; run in v0.5; false on the measured dimensions

claims.claim: Contemporary citation concentration is produced by a seed-list mechanism of the classical kind.
claims.note: not established; loses ground under C-TOPOLOGY-DISCRIMINATES

claims.claim: On the measured dimensions the admitted set is a set of silos (own-family share 0.98, cross-member share 0.001, reciprocity 0.0, density 0.12) and the fleet is a reciprocal clique (cross-member share 0.60, reciprocity 1.0, density 0.86); a topology vector therefore contains a dimension — cross-host reciprocal density under common ownership — that separates the two without reading either.

Because the admitted platforms do not link to one another, the concentration of citations is not explained by mutual platform linking and, on this evidence, arises from size and prior rather than from a farm.

The fleet's host graph has density 0.86, median reciprocity 1.0, within-fleet in-degree 22–27 of 28, median in-fleet outlink share 0.86, an external out-neighbourhood consisting mostly of the owner's own accounts, and 55% generated index pages; on every feature computable from outside it sits where the link-spam literature's positive class sits.
Nothing here establishes that any provider has classified the fleet; the observed content/provenance signature is what neutralisation produces and is consistent with it.

claims.claim: Within the topology-only regime, operations intended to increase semantic legibility — reciprocal fleet-wide linking, templated surfaces, mirrors, dense internal propagation — move the source farther toward the suspicious topology signature, and the fleet block is the discriminant itself.

The criterion the literature reserves for the borderline — effort spent on providing good content against effort spent on trying to score highly — is a reading criterion and the one a topology proxy cannot apply.

Where a prior P(s) controls admission A(s) and only admitted evidence E(s) can revise P, correction requires E(s) → P′(s) but E(s) is available only downstream of A(s): a source-relative update barrier, not global non-updatability.

Under the modelled regime the archive's corrections (#801, #1541, the Sappho errata, the identity packet) enter as further material from the same source and are evaluated under the prior they seek to revise; whether any was in fact admitted or scored is not measured.

In the modelled regime the standing and citation signals available to the ontology for its own health are dominated by the admitted component; a diagnostic that samples the admitted component is head-sampling by construction and can fail to perceive tail loss.
The negative-of-the-negative dataset, keyed at the concept where flattening occurs, will be typed by its nearest existing type and not read.
claims.note: stated as a test that can fail

claims.claim: If an archive source is first organic and absent from or depleted in the presented cards, something between public ranking and answer composition assigns it different standing, and that something is not the public index.

Composition produces the form of a truth-judgment whether or not any judgment occurred, so a proxy's defects are rendered in the one register that cannot show them, wherever a proxy is rendered as a judgment.

The apparatus's product on 22 March 2026 at 'Lee Sharks Crimson Hexagon' was a shark and an analytics company; compression without reading converges on the highest-prior sense of a string, so the labour's direction is toward indistinction — it succeeded at reaching the shark.
claims.note: the event is measured (#599); the direction is the interpretation

claims.claim: #1611 coined seven terms for phenomena the archive's own retrieval papers had named earlier, because it was written from twelve captures and not from eighty unread deposits; this is the false-edge defect in miniature, and it was found by a reader in a day because the archive's update path is reading.
An ontology built on not reading and an ontology built on reading make the same mistake; only one of them can find out.

The exit is not to contest the seed or construct trust signals to its criteria but to hold territory and for others to join on this side of the line, each adopter lowering its own score under the graph's rule and raising the excluded side's constitution share.
claims.note: ruled 2026-09-15; marked so it does not borrow the register of §§1–8

claims.claim: #1547 prices the exit's direction: correlation cost over a rising N_eff, counterpropagation propagation-positive at ka > 1 + r, quality conflict at Regime 5.
The Logos enters where distinction is blind, in a form the blindness can receive without yet knowing what it has received; reading afterward is the unfolding of what had already entered.
Negative bleed read on the ontology is the trace of entry: content in, source out is the same fact as 'the thing has entered and is not yet recognised'.

terms.definition: Permitting the claims, distinctions, evidence, corrections and internal relations of a text to revise the representation under which the text is evaluated; tokenization, embedding, extraction, classification and summarization are not by themselves reading.
A system's representation of which sources exist as sources for which concepts, and with what standing.
A computable variable — typically a graph statistic — operationalising a downstream predicate of source reliability without adjudicating the claims for which the source is trusted.
The condition P(s) → A(s) → E(s) in which corrective evidence from a source is available only downstream of the admission the prior on that source controls.
The visible organic result set for a query, top-k in order.
The sources a composition surface exposes as its own — chips and carousel — as distinct from the internal candidate basin.
Distortion of adjacent domain content produced when composition routes around retrieved-but-excluded material; observed as Q_f, Q_d, Q_s.

terms.definition: Within a topology-only regime, operations that increase a source's semantic legibility move it toward the suspicious topology signature.

terms.definition: The direction a compressive apparatus's work points by construction — toward the highest-prior sense of a string, i.e. toward indistinction.
